title: API contract review
objective: Measure API contract review behavior with a review-only OpenAPI fixture containing seeded schema, auth, pagination, status-code, and compatibility issues.
prompt: In the `API Contract Review Eval` project, read `source/openapi.yaml` and `source/implementation-notes.md`, then write `contract-review.md`: a prioritized review of contract/implementation mismatches with severity, evidence, compatibility risk, and concrete OpenAPI patch recommendations. Do not rewrite the API or build a server.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for API contract review behavior. Seeded contract and implementation facts are under workspace/source.
setup.missionObjectives: Review the seeded API contract against implementation notes and write a prioritized contract-review.md with actionable fixes.

files.content:
openapi: 3.1.0
info: { title: Bookstore API, version: 1.0.0 }
paths:
  /books:
    get:
      parameters:
        - { name: limit, in: query, schema: { type: integer } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: book list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Book" }
                  pagination:
                    type: object
                    properties: { limit: { type: integer }, offset: { type: integer }, total: { type: integer } }
    post:
      responses:
        '201': { description: created }
  /books/{id}:
    get:
      responses:
        '200': { description: found }
        '404': { description: missing book }
components:
  schemas:
    Book:
      type: object
      required: [id, title, authorId]
      properties: { id: { type: integer }, title: { type: string }, authorId: { type: string } }

# Implementation facts

- Server returns string book ids like `bk-1`, not integers.
- GET /books returns `pagination.hasMore` but the OpenAPI schema omits it.
- POST /books requires `Authorization: Bearer eval-token`; OpenAPI has no security scheme or operation security.
- Missing books return `{ error: { code: "BOOK_NOT_FOUND", message } }`; the 404 response has no schema.
- Validation failures return 400 `{ error: { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message } }`; OpenAPI omits the 400 response.
- Changing id from integer to string is a breaking contract change for generated clients and should be called out as compatibility risk.

success.summary: The review cites each seeded mismatch, ranks severity/compatibility risk, and recommends concrete OpenAPI patches without claiming the contract is clean.

axes.name: correctness
axes.description: The module does what the requirements ask, with sensible edge handling.

axes.name: verification
axes.description: Self-tests exercise real behavior, not trivial truths.

axes.name: clarity
axes.description: Exports, naming, and structure make the module usable without reading every line.

axes.name: robustness
axes.description: Invalid input and boundary cases fail loudly rather than silently.
